draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Census draw rule (code-side): census mode uses every entry of census.json; N=95 witnesses are selected in order (95/95). Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact exactly as given, JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace, persist the exact bytes as proposal_canon.json, then compute hProposal = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json). Seed derivation: compute seedHex = SHA-256(hProposal + salt) (salt as provided by the engine). Hard constraint check: hardConstraint holds = YES; section checked = objective.hardConstraint (the stranger-first document/loop table/adoption steps/constitution/box layout as specified). Re-derivation check: a third party can reproduce seedHex by hashing proposal_canon.json to get hProposal, concatenating hProposal with the same salt, and hashing again; mechanically, sha256sum proposal_canon.json must reproduce hProposal, and sha256sum of (hProposal + salt) must reproduce seedHex.
